description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Spell checking now closes its review dialog automatically when finished, without a separate completion popup. Clean documents complete without opening a dialog. Removed SpellCheckOptions.AlertComplete and CompleteAlertMessage; remove assignments to these properties before recompiling. SpellCheckCompleted and its Canceled flag remain available for custom status messages. Removed the unused SpellCheck_CompleteAlert localization key.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
